description: This file defines custom error classes and a structured error payload for an API backend, including specific error types like NotFoundError, ConflictError, DatabaseError, and DbNotConfiguredError.

classes.name: ApiErrorPayload
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a structured error payload returned to API clients.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Base class for application errors, extending Exception, with additional attributes for error code, message, and details.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Error raised when an entity cannot be found, inherits from AppError.

classes.name: ConflictError
classes.description: Error raised when an operation conflicts with current state, inherits from AppError.

classes.name: DatabaseError
classes.description: Error raised during known database operation failures, inherits from AppError.

classes.name: DbNotConfiguredError
classes.description: Error raised when a database-backed endpoint is called without proper configuration, inherits from AppError.

methods.name: ApiErrorPayload.__init__

methods.description: Constructor for AppError, initializes code, message, and optional details.

methods.name: NotFoundError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a NotFoundError with a standard code 'NOT_FOUND' and custom message/details.

methods.name: ConflictError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a ConflictError with code 'CONFLICT' and custom message/details.

methods.name: DatabaseError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a DatabaseError with code 'DATABASE_ERROR' and custom message/details.

methods.name: DbNotConfiguredError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a DbNotConfiguredError with code 'DB_NOT_CONFIGURED' and custom message/details.
